headline: 愛丁堡藝穗有木偶德古拉
context: 法國—挪威劇團 Plexus Polaire 把一齣真人比例的木偶德古拉搬上愛丁堡藝穗（Edinburgh Fringe）舞台，劇名《Dracula: Lucy's Dream》，由伊薇德・阿斯佩利（Yngvild Aspeli）執導。另外，蘇格蘭鄧地的 V&A 博物館正在回顧建築師凱瑟琳・芬德利（Kathryn Findlay）與艾薩庫・內田（Eisaku Ushida）的作品，代表作是 1994 年完工、位於東京的「毛茸茸的房子」（Soft and Hairy House）。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The dreaded bloodsucker will be getting his fangs into the Edinburgh fringe this year – in a deeply creepy, liberty-taking show with a sisterly twist. We meet its director Who is your Dracula? Max Schreck’s toothy Nosferatu, Bela Lugosi in a tux, the lantern-jawed host of Hotel Transylvania? This notorious shapeshifter “exists for us even before we know who he is” says theatre director Yngvild Aspeli , who is bringing a puppet bloodsucker to the Edinburgh fringe this summer. “There were stories of vampires long before Bram Stoker but he gave new life to them.” After watching her deeply creepy show Dracula: Lucy’s Dream , that eerily waxen, lifesized puppet has for me become as indelible as top-hatted Gary Oldman or gorily grinning Christopher Lee. It matches Jonathan Harker’s assessment of the count in Stoker’s novel: “The general effect was one of extraordinary pallor.” I saw the show on tour in Paris several months ago and it still haunts me: I could swear this Drac disintegrated then reappeared before my eyes, such is the technical sophistication of Aspeli’s French-Norwegian company Plexus Polaire. Thanks in part to Emilie Nguyen’s spectral lighting, stunning transformations take place, with the actors and puppets frequently becoming indistinguishable. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘It still haunts me’: the puppet show Dracula that’s definitely not for small children

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: V&A Dundee When Kathryn Findlay and Eisaku Ushida joined forces, a sensual kind of architecture was born – resulting in a hairy blue pod in Tokyo and a starfish beach palace in Qatar ‘The future of architecture,” pronounced Salvador Dalí on meeting Le Corbusier in 1922, “will be soft and hairy.” Fast forward over 70 years to Tokyo, and his surrealist prophecy was the stimulus for the Soft and Hairy House, one of a series of startlingly expressive dwellings designed by the talented Scottish-Japanese architectural partnership of Kathryn Findlay and Eisaku Ushida. Melding diverse design cultures – Celtic coiling and Japanese “rawness” – overlaid by an interest in the natural world, as well as fractal geometries and chaos theory, the pair contrived a uniquely sensual and surreal architecture. Completed in 1994, the Soft and Hairy House was based on a classic courtyard plan form, radically reworked for pre-millennial Tokyo, its softness accentuated by plumply rounded contours, its hairiness by a shaggy fringe of greenery embellishing the roof. A bright blue, porthole-percolated bathroom pod intruded into the courtyard like a giant fungal entity. The interior was suggestive of the glamorous dream space of a Hollywood star, with soft draperies and seductive lighting. Continue reading...
sources.title: Ushida Findlay review: the mighty culture clash that gave us the dazzling Soft and Hairy House

thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗有木偶德古拉

法國—挪威劇團 Plexus Polaire 把一齣真人比例的木偶德古拉搬上愛丁堡藝穗（Edinburgh Fringe）舞台，劇名《Dracula: Lucy's Dream》，由伊薇德・阿斯佩利（Yngvild Aspeli）執導，燈光出自艾蜜莉・阮（Emilie Nguyen）之手，據說效果相當逼真、令人毛骨悚然。

另一邊，蘇格蘭鄧地的 V&A 博物館正在回顧建築師凱瑟琳・芬德利（Kathryn Findlay）與艾薩庫・內田（Eisaku Ushida）的作品。兩人的代表作「毛茸茸的房子」（Soft and Hairy House）1994 年完工於東京，靈感部分來自達利（Salvador Dalí）1922 年對柯比意（Le Corbusier）說的一句話：「建築的未來將會是又軟又毛。」

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 7 日發佈的報導。

voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗今年有一齣真人比例的木偶德古拉。法國挪威劇團 Plexus Polaire 帶來《Dracula: Lucy's Dream》，由伊薇德・阿斯佩利執導，效果據說相當逼真，看過的人形容陰魂不散。建築這邊也有消息，蘇格蘭鄧地的 V&A 博物館正在回顧建築師凱瑟琳・芬德利與艾薩庫・內田的作品，兩人的代表作「毛茸茸的房子」1994 年完工於東京，靈感部分來自達利對柯比意說的一句話：建築的未來將會又軟又毛。
